regions.full_page: Mrs. Clara Monart - Keystone near 6 mile Rd. - 34 - with five children & husband, went to "healer" - was advised that she would cure her. The first time she went into the place some- thing about "seemed uncaney" Then she hoped that by going back & paying for her treatment she might be relieved of the "spell" she seemed to be suffering ..... This time was convinced that the woman is healer for Hell. She and her whole family have suffered as though under a curse ever since. From fear and agony at times has terrible perspirations. Get's blessing To-night and promises perpetual enrollment if better.
